articles.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
articles.snippet: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Binance’s $6.4B Hack Overshadows Hyperliquid’s Biggest Day
articles.snippet: Just as Hyperliquid opened the door to a fully regulated perps offering inside the U.S., Binance suffered the biggest hack in crypto history.

articles.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
articles.snippet: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.
